clue.text: What striped tiger, say, has upset asinine lot

indicators.note: something upset is knocked over and thrown into disorder, so the letters must be rearranged

blocks.note: a tiger is an example of a big cat
the ten letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A tiger with a stripy coat apparently annoys a foolish crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Striped' looks like the tiger's coat, but here it is the past tense of stripe, to lash: the cat-o'-nine-tails is what did the striping.
explanation.definitionFit: The cat-o'-nine-tails was a knotted whip used for flogging, the instrument that left stripes, or weals, on a back.

clue.text: Stolen goods dealer's wealth is something to die for

blocks.note: capital is accumulated money or assets
the possessive turned round as of
a fence is a receiver of stolen property

explanation.surface: A receiver's hoard of riches is something worth killing for.
explanation.walkthrough: The fence's wealth becomes the wealth of the fence. 'Something to die for' sounds like praise but means literally a crime punishable by death.
explanation.definitionFit: A capital offence is a crime for which the penalty is execution, so committing it is a thing one could die for.

clue.text: Go round one European city

indicators.note: round says the verb's letters go about the numeral

blocks.note: a go is a turn, as in a game
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A traveller's instruction to circle a single continental city.
explanation.definitionFit: Turin is a major city in northwest Italy, capital of Piedmont.

clue.text: Thought about bird's proposal

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the idea's letters wrap the bird

blocks.note: a notion is an idea
mina is a variant spelling of myna, an Asian starling

explanation.surface: Someone muses over a bird's offer.
explanation.walkthrough: The myna, an Asian starling known for mimicry, is also spelt mina.
explanation.definitionFit: A nomination is the putting forward of someone for a post, a proposal of their name.

clue.text: Agent we tortured in prison once

indicators.note: tortured means twisted out of shape, so the letters are wrenched into another arrangement

blocks.note: the seven letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A spy is mistreated by us while locked up in a historic jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Newgate was London's notorious jail for centuries until it was demolished in 1904.

clue.text: Cuff link exchanged for another male accessory

indicators.note: exchanged means the two words swap places once each has been replaced

blocks.note: a tie is a link or bond
to cuff and to clip both mean to strike lightly

explanation.surface: A man swaps his cufflinks for a different piece of jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cuff link' reads as one item, but each word is swapped for a synonym and the pair change order.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie clip holds a necktie to the shirt and, like cufflinks, is a piece of men's dress jewellery.

clue.text: Did less? Mostly this

indicators.note: mostly says most but not all of the letters are used, so the answer lies within the words

blocks.note: the answer sits inside these two words

explanation.surface: Asking whether doing less was mostly just this.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: to idle is to do less than one might.
explanation.definitionFit: To idle is to spend time doing little or nothing, so someone who idled did less work.

clue.text: Drama as a pontiff is placed above God

indicators.note: in a down entry, placed above means coming earlier in the column

blocks.note: so and as both mean in the way that
taken as written
the pontiff is the Pope
Ra was the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: A theatrical situation in which a pope is ranked higher than the Almighty.
explanation.definitionFit: A soap opera is a serialised domestic TV or radio drama, named for the soap firms that once sponsored them.

clue.text: Go with chaps to match as organised by divisions?

blocks.note: to depart is to go away
chaps are men
to tally is to correspond or match

explanation.surface: Leaving with the lads for a game, sorted by club sections.
explanation.definitionFit: Departmentally is an adverb meaning by or in terms of departments, the separate sections of an organisation.

clue.text: Uniform used in particular Jewish festival

indicators.note: a thing used in something else is put inside it, so one piece goes within the other

blocks.note: prim means fussy or particular about propriety
U is Uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Special clothing worn at a certain religious celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: Purim is the spring holiday commemorating the deliverance of the Jews told in the Book of Esther.

clue.text: Characteristic of vehicles with tail end low

blocks.note: W is a standard abbreviation for with
the heel is the end piece, as of a loaf
base means low or ignoble

explanation.surface: A car that sits low at the back, as if describing a design feature.
explanation.definitionFit: The wheelbase, the distance between front and rear axles, is a measurable property of any car or lorry.

clue.text: Note granny has place to eat suitable for renting out

blocks.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
nan is an informal word for grandmother
people sit at a table for meals

explanation.surface: Grandma has a dining room fit to let to lodgers, as a note in a property ad.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tenantable is in a fit state to be occupied by a tenant, so it can be rented.

clue.text: Old garment from Pacific islands, never new

indicators.note: never means without, so the following abbreviation is to be dropped from the islands

blocks.note: Tonga is a Polynesian island kingdom
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A traditional costume from the South Seas that has never been worn.
explanation.definitionFit: The toga was the draped woollen robe worn by citizens of ancient Rome.

clue.text: The French franc holds little pain for socialist

indicators.note: holds means the currency's abbreviation encloses the small hurt

blocks.note: le is French for the
Fr is an abbreviation for franc
a twinge is a brief, minor pain

explanation.surface: French currency causes a socialist only a slight ache.
explanation.definitionFit: A left-winger holds views on the left of politics, as a socialist does.

clue.text: Unruly girl and others around unruly boy returned

indicators.note: around says the first piece encloses the next one
something returned goes back the way it came, so the combined letters are read backwards

blocks.note: et al is Latin shorthand for and others
a Ted, short for Teddy boy, was a rowdy 1950s British youth

explanation.surface: A badly behaved girl and her friends surround a returning delinquent boy.
explanation.walkthrough: A Teddy boy was a 1950s British youth in Edwardian-style dress with a reputation for rowdiness.
explanation.definitionFit: A ladette is a young woman who behaves in a loud, boisterous, hard-drinking way associated with lads.

clue.text: Performer of hepatectomy perhaps is a saviour

blocks.note: first meaning, whimsical: one who takes out a liver
second meaning: one who rescues or sets free

explanation.surface: A liver surgeon is hailed as a life-saver.
explanation.walkthrough: A hepatectomy is the surgical removal of all or part of the liver, so its surgeon whimsically 'de-livers'.
explanation.definitionFit: A deliverer frees people from danger or captivity, which is what a saviour does.

clue.text: Excuse for acting before script is here?

blocks.note: pre is a prefix meaning before
a text is written words, a script

explanation.surface: An actor asks whether there is any reason to perform before the script arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Acting' suggests the theatre, with the script to match, but the definition means a reason given for doing something.
explanation.definitionFit: A pretext is a false reason offered to justify an action, an excuse for doing it.

clue.text: Decline of following after one season

indicators.note: after places the first two pieces behind the season in the answer

blocks.note: fall is the American name for autumn
taken as written
F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

explanation.surface: A drop-off in support after a single season, as of a sports club.
explanation.definitionFit: A fall-off is a noun for a reduction or decrease, the same as a decline.

clue.text: Language sounding like Polish?

indicators.note: sounding like means the answer is pronounced the same as another word

blocks.note: polish as a verb means put the final touches to, which is to finish

explanation.surface: Asking which tongue is similar to the language of Poland.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital-P 'Polish' looks like the language of Poland; it is the verb polish, meaning finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Finnish is the Uralic language spoken in Finland.

clue.text: Aviary, excessive inside small building

indicators.note: inside places the word for excessive within the aviary

blocks.note: an aviary is a large cage for birds
OTT stands for over the top

explanation.surface: An overly elaborate bird enclosure inside a little shed.
explanation.walkthrough: OTT, over the top, is common British shorthand for excessive.
explanation.definitionFit: A cottage is a small house, typically in the country.

clue.text: Conservative cut by utter defeat? One such could be in the soup

definitions.text: One such could be in the soup

indicators.note: something cut by another thing has that thing driven into its middle

blocks.note: Con is short for Conservative
a rout is a crushing defeat

explanation.surface: A Tory politician brought down by a landslide loss ends up in trouble, or in the soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the soup' is an idiom for in trouble, which suits the beaten Tory; here it is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: A crouton is a small cube of fried or toasted bread served floating in soup.

clue.text: Nevada reduced reported sin

indicators.note: reported means passed on by word of mouth, so what counts is how the letters are said

blocks.note: Nevada cut down to its postal abbreviation NV, said as two letters

explanation.surface: Las Vegas, in a smaller Nevada, is said to be a den of sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is one of the seven deadly sins in Christian teaching.

clue.text: Perhaps bitter and against insincere talk around football team

blocks.note: into in the sense of crashing against something
a football side has eleven players, XI in Roman numerals
cant is hypocritical, sanctimonious talk

explanation.surface: A beer-drinker objects to hollow chatter surrounding a football club.
explanation.walkthrough: The ordering is loose: 'around' just sets the cant beside the team rather than enclosing it, and several solvers queried into for against. Bitter is a British style of hoppy draught beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitter, the British ale, is an example of an alcoholic drink, which is an intoxicant.

clue.text: Indian city set around old marketplace

indicators.note: set around means placed about something, so the city surrounds the next piece

blocks.note: Agra is the city of the Taj Mahal
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: An Indian city built around an ancient bazaar.
explanation.definitionFit: The agora was the public open space used for markets and assemblies in an ancient Greek city.

clue.text: A united country

blocks.note: per means a, as in twice a day
U is the abbreviation for united, as in football club names

explanation.surface: A unified nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Peru is a nation on the Pacific coast of South America.

clue.text: One concerned with promotion run by centre in Bristol

indicators.note: the centre of a word is its middle letters, so only those are kept

blocks.note: to career is to rush along headlong
the three middle letters of the city's name

explanation.surface: An ambitious employee runs the head office in Bristol, an English port city.
explanation.definitionFit: A careerist is someone mainly focused on advancing up the ladder at work, so getting promoted matters most.

clue.text: Sound threatening to increase loudness initially

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word just before it

blocks.note: to grow is to increase
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A warning noise as the volume starts to rise.
explanation.definitionFit: A growl is a low, menacing noise made by an angry dog, a threatening sound.

clue.text: Crude thug with money

blocks.note: a rough is a violent hooligan
with and and both mean together with
the ready, or readies, is slang for cash

explanation.surface: A boorish hoodlum who has cash on him.
explanation.walkthrough: The ready is British slang for available cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough-and-ready means makeshift and unrefined, which is what crude describes.
